description: §14.8.10 (S455) — `CREATE TABLE notes (id, body)` followed by `ALTER TABLE notes ADD COLUMN tenant_id TEXT` in `<schema>`: the schema carries a `tenant_id` column for `notes`, so `notes` is tenant-scoped and its read is filtered at the source (I-TENANT-STRIP). Before S455 only CREATE TABLE column lists and DSL heads were read: the read was emitted unfiltered and pinned tenant A received B's note (executed on e014f20ce). The CREATE without `tenant_id` and the ALTER that adds it AGREE — no E-SCHEMA-015.
rationale: §14.8.10: "A table whose `<schema>` carries a `tenant_id` column IS tenant-scoped; the column's presence is the declaration." S455: an `ALTER TABLE <t>` statement in `<schema>` that names `tenant_id` makes `<t>` tenant-scoped.
